snippet.title: Robotron X (Playstation - 1996) Hi Score 3696650 Longplay (HD)
snippet.description: Over 3 hours of absolutely intense, balls to the wall, white knuckle, clenched bottom, sweaty palm action on the oft-overlooked Robotron X for the original Playstation. This was so close to being a complete run through that I'm tempted to try it again one day...but not until my nerves have settled!
